item.title: Letter: New faces, new ideas good for Gilroy | Gilroy Dispatch | Gilroy, California
item.description: Our new mayor is showing leadership instead of being centered on himself like our last mayor. He is a man for the people. He cares about the community and that’s what leadership is all about.

item.title: Gilroy woman accused of neglect leading to homicide | Gilroy Dispatch | Gilroy, California
item.description: A Gilroy woman was arrested on suspicion of felony abuse after a disabled San Jose man she had been taking care of was found dead, according to authorities.
